
The table [@tbl-TS] summarizes the shear modulus $G_o$, maximum shear velocity at the base $v_S^o$, inhomogeneity factor $m_o$ and fundamental periods $T_s$ adopted for the project slopes for different probability levels.



```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-TS
#| tbl-cap: "Shear modulus, shear-wave velocity, inhomogeneity factor and fundamental period for different probability levels" 
#| column: body-outset-right
#| 
TS |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 11,font.size.header = 11)|>  
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("Go","VSo"),decimals = 0) |>  
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("mo","an"),decimals = 3)  |> 
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("Ts"), decimals = 2) 
  
```
